title.narrative: Reproductive Health Training Center of the Republic of Moldova

description.narrative: The Reproductive Health Training Center of the Republic of Moldova (RHTC) is a non-governmental organization (NGO) founded by a passionate and innovative group of obstetrician-gynecologists (ob/gyns) with the mission of protecting and promoting the sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) of all people, especially women and girls. They envision a world in which every person, no matter their residence, sex, gender, age, ethnicity, or physical or mental condition, are able to freely and openly exercise their sexual and reproductive rights and have ready access to quality sexual and reproductive health services. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Cover the costs for sexual and reproductive health services they provide, including the model SRH center focused most particularly on serving the most vulnerable; - Raise awareness about sexual and reproductive health and rights by optimizing and modernizing their organizational website, developing and refining our visual identity, creating and promoting informational video materials, and active communications strategies; - Provide further support to participants of training of trainers in their efforts to carry out informational sessions with peers in their communities; - Strengthen the capacity of their team, enhance the efficiency of collaborative efforts among staff members, and encourage growth and development at every step of our activity together.
